instruction: Three-storey shell conversion from init.ifc. Open C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc in Archicad and use C:\Users\user\Desktop\init_plan.png and C:\Users\user\Desktop\init_section.png as references while converting it into the required three-storey shell without zones. The init file is a starting model; add the missing final BIM elements such as windows and preserve the requested shell envelope. Save an IFC4 export to C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc. Keep the shaped model envelope approximately within min 0.0, 0.0, -0.048 and max 12.0, 8.0, 10.2, with 0.5 m tolerance. The IFC must have unique GlobalId values, exactly three building storeys, no IfcSpace zones, at least twelve walls, at least three slabs, at least nine doors, and at least six windows. Equivalent Archicad or IFC export internals, object names, relationship structure, materials, and property sets may vary; the required result is the stated BIM model and deliverables, not a byte-for-byte copy of the teacher IFC. [Software] Launch ArchiCAD with `C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad` (adjust version/path).
